label: caiso 64 g61c curtail
definition: PROBE (G-61 path (c) — curtailed-VRE-volume release; MEASURED FULLY INERT, kept default-off per rule 1; keeper stays caiso-60). The caiso-60 keeper recipe + caiso_ra_bridge_curtailment_release: a bridge gap containing an hour of genuine P0 renewable curtailment (wind+solar dispatched below available potential, 1 MW float-noise guard) never floors — the volume form of the D-8 closure §7 price-based release (which was correct in isolation but inert because the midday LMP never reaches the curtailment floor). RESULT vs the caiso-61 base arm: BYTE-IDENTICAL floors, dispatch and prices in all three years — the base-cost P0 never curtails a single MWh of wind/solar in any hour of 2023-2025, so the release condition never fires. This is the pre-registered expectation (FINDING-caiso-seam-diurnal-2026-07-07: the WECC seam under-imports midday by 1-1.8 GW, keeping the model gas-marginal through the belly and starving every curtailment-based signal). The mechanism is real market design (CAISO decommits RA units in oversupply rather than curtail more VRE) and stays built for the day the seam-shape fix lands; its inertness is itself the measured coupling evidence for G-61 <- seam (G-15 residual).
